problem_type: Model settings action copy and walkthrough contracts
symptom: Control copy exceeds the bilingual limit and walkthroughs use stale selectors and unproven absence checks.
direct_cause: Navigation copied page titles into buttons, retry buttons owned status text and older walks still targeted the retired adapted-platform list.
class_root: The new settings surfaces reused descriptive text at action boundaries while walkthroughs still assumed the retired home layout and treated a single absence sample as proof.
affected_population: Model settings users in both languages and the walks that verify fresh and migrated profiles
entry_points: Settings models home, account usage, other connection methods and the registered desktop walkthroughs
internal_only_reason: The approved ModelSurfaces board, the Nomi design system and existing repository gates own these contracts.
invariants: Visible action labels fit the bilingual length limit. Retry status text is outside its button.
Walkthroughs anchor current surfaces and prove the probe before asserting absence.

door_reduction.why_not: The drawer selects home, usage and other methods as distinct pages. Home owns the account summary, whose time window and read states differ from the usage detail.

generality_proof: Both locales use the same JSX boundaries. The two retry buttons own only the retry translation, and walkthrough absence checks use the existing proven-probe and sustained-sampling assertion.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Renders the status and retry action as siblings for both independent reads.
Requires a proven probe and holds the absence check through asynchronous rendering.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The usage trigger has a dedicated compact label and the destination retains its full heading.
The other connection methods trigger has a compact label with a separate descriptive hint.
The custom API and existing-script actions use compact localized labels.

recurrence.reason: Both read failures used the same invalid button structure. Multiple consumers still referenced the retired list.
same_class_scan: Ran door-map for ModelSettingsHome, ModelAccountCard, OtherConnectionWays, ModelUsagePage and useModelUsage.
Searched model-home anchors in tests/ux and usage, other methods, retry status and connection summary translations in renderer callers.

prevention.invariant: Retry hit targets contain action copy only. The existing control and walkthrough gates enforce the same rules on future changes.
prevention.failure_mode: Failed reads remain visible beside a retry, and invalid button text or stale walk assertions fail their existing gates.
prevention.strategy: Keep the read state separate from the button at the render boundary, and use proven probes and the currently rendered anchors in walks.

legacy_paths.rationale: Separates the two status-bearing retry controls and retires the old adapted-platform navigation in the agreement walk.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The behavior is owned by the settings renderer and its existing static and desktop checks.

migration: Existing credentials and settings use their current storage format. Existing walkthroughs target the current model settings surfaces.
residual_risks: Desktop evidence uses isolated fixture data. Real provider reads and billing are outside this repair.
